title: T1598.004 — Phishing for Information - Spearphishing Voice
subtitle: The animation below replays a classic voice attack in eight steps: an attacker studies a target, spoofs the help-desk number, pressures an employee into sharing an MFA code,...
aria: Animated simulation of spearphishing voice. An attacker spoofs caller ID, impersonates the IT help desk, pressure leads to a shared MFA code, and the SOC revokes access in eight steps.

nodes.label: Attacker
nodes.tip: The voice on the line. Calm, confident, and in a hurry to help you help them.

nodes.label: Phone Network
nodes.tip: The phone network. Caller ID can be spoofed, so it proves nothing.

nodes.label: Employee
nodes.tip: The person holding the phone. Trust is the exploited surface.

nodes.label: Help Desk
nodes.tip: Your first line. Strong verification here stops most voice attacks.

nodes.label: IdP / MFA
nodes.tip: Your identity provider. MFA satisfaction from an odd context is a key clue.

nodes.label: SOC / IR
nodes.tip: Your responders. They revoke, verify out-of-band, and fix the process.

steps.title: Study target
steps.caption: The attacker maps the org chart and learns shift times from public posts and press releases.
steps.defender: OSINT exposure sets the stage. Keep staffing details out of public posts.

fields.detail: The attacker maps the org chart and learns shift times from public posts and press releases.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Spoof ID
steps.caption: The call shows the real IT help desk number on the screen. The display is part of the trick.
steps.defender: Caller ID proves nothing. Say this in training until everyone repeats it.

fields.detail: The call shows the real IT help desk number on the screen. The display is part of the trick.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Pretext
steps.caption: 'This is IT. We are closing your account unless you re-verify right now.' Authority plus urgency.
steps.defender: Urgency plus authority is the classic social-engineering pattern.

fields.detail: 'This is IT. We are closing your account unless you re-verify right now.' Authority plus urgency.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Pressure
steps.caption: The caller adds fear: payroll stops, security alerts, a supervisor will call. Think fast or lose access.
steps.defender: Real IT never asks for passwords or codes. Repeat it in every drill.

fields.detail: The caller adds fear: payroll stops, security alerts, a supervisor will call. Think fast or lose acc

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Code shared
steps.caption: The employee reads back the MFA code, or sets a new password while the caller stays on the line.
steps.defender: IdP logs show MFA satisfied from an odd context, right after the call.

fields.detail: The employee reads back the MFA code, or sets a new password while the caller stays on the line.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Log in
steps.caption: The attacker signs in and registers their own MFA device so they no longer need the victim.
steps.defender: New MFA enrollment is a high-severity event. Alert on it directly.

fields.detail: The attacker signs in and registers their own MFA device so they no longer need the victim.

detection.label: Partial signal
detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Escalate
steps.caption: With a valid session, the attacker reads mail and hunts for more targets and data.
steps.defender: Impossible travel and unusual mailbox reads betray the session.

fields.detail: With a valid session, the attacker reads mail and hunts for more targets and data.

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: Revoke
steps.caption: The SOC kills the session and calls the employee back on a verified number. The help desk rule changes.
steps.defender: Verify out-of-band. Never trust the number that called you.

detection.detail: The activity is contained and the lesson is captured.
